gloss: dominant arm; dominant hand; strong arm

definitions.gloss: dominant arm; dominant hand; preferred hand
definitions.explanation: The arm or hand that a person naturally uses more skillfully, typically for writing, throwing, and other tasks.

examples.japanese: {利|き}き{腕|うで}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{利|き}き{腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。

⟦ピッチャー→ピッチャー：09482_picchaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{利|き}き{腕|うで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The batter's strategy changes depending on whether the pitcher is left-handed or right-handed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{利|き}き→利く：11845_kiku⟧ (dominant/effective, from ⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ 'to be effective') + ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ (arm). Often used interchangeably with ⟦{利|き}き{手|て}→利き手：19086_kikite⟧ (dominant hand), though {利|き}き{腕|うで} specifically refers to the arm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利|き}き{腕|うで}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧: right-handed (dominant arm is the right)
- {利|き}き{腕|うで}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧: left-handed (dominant arm is the left)
- {利|き}き{腕|うで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{怪我|けが}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to injure one's dominant arm

RELATED {利|き}き WORDS:
- ⟦{利|き}き{手|て}→利き手：19086_kikite⟧: dominant hand — the most common term for handedness
- {利|き}き{足|あし}: dominant foot/leg
- {利|き}き{目|め}: dominant eye

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利|き}き{手|て}→利き手：19086_kikite⟧: dominant hand — more general and common in everyday conversation
- ⟦{右利|みぎき}き→右利き：17053_migikiki⟧: right-handed
- ⟦{左利|ひだりき}き→左利き：22396_hidarikiki⟧: left-handed
